entries.label: Modern textures — 16 common blocks in a 4x4 grid
entries.method: Unmasked 1:1 paste of native 256x256 RGBA cells from the fixed TextureAtlasGenerator export. No resizing, recoloring, compositing mask, or resampling; 1024x1024, 4x4 grid.
entries.notes: Order: grass block, dirt, stone, cobblestone, oak planks, oak log, oak leaves, glass, sand, gravel, bricks, bookshelf, crafting table, furnace, chest, obsidian. All 16 saved icon cells and separately saved cells are byte-identical to their source export rectangles; see icon-proof.json. Icon SHA256 07d54e88ff01ebf37e0a15da57e811de26c00aa87341fdcef2607fc3b5b6e838.

entries.label: Raw fixed native 256px export used by matching-block icon
entries.method: Unmodified file copy of the surviving examples export, hash-verified against the recorded fixed/config-0 export; JSON copied directly from fixed/config-0.
entries.notes: The original fixed/config-0 PNG is no longer present, but this archived raw copy is identical to its recorded SHA256 c9baa75bac9a498b4d3a5be106ca75163e4d3e33aaa599618f7aba4485cdd681. 8192x12288, 1536 mapped items, all 16 required cells present. No regeneration needed. Exact provenance in atlas4/source-provenance.json.

reproduce.inputs: The script reopens the saved icon and each cell PNG and compares decoded RGBA bytes with the raw export.
